subject: You've been invited
heading: You've been invited
body: Hi {{name}}, an admin has created an account for you. Use the button below to choose your password. That also confirms your email address, so you can sign in with it right after.
linkNote: This link works once and expires in {{days}} days. If it has expired, ask your admin to send a new link, or use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page.
ignoreFooter: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.
